description: This file defines a PHP class 'ThemeVariables' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\CorporateBranding\Dto'. The class encapsulates various theme-related color variables such as primary and secondary colors, font colors, and gradient colors, along with getter methods and a static factory method 'createFromArray'. It is a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent theme customization parameters in the OrangeHRM corporate branding module.

classes.name: ThemeVariables
classes.description: A data transfer object representing theme color variables used in the OrangeHRM corporate branding system, including primary and secondary colors and gradients, with accessor methods and a factory creation method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all theme color properties with provided string values.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientStartColor
methods.description: Returns the start color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: getPrimaryGradientEndColor
methods.description: Returns the end color of the primary gradient.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeVariables instance from an associative array containing the theme attribute values.
